result:
task: Revise W1-01's integration-merge case so that `merge_offences` reads the path map's `acceptance_exemptions` (DEC-906, DEC-908 item 3), with one fixture case per KPI clause (DAEO-uzme, W2-70).
status: DONE. Commit `39574e4e` is in, it touches only my two paths, and the whole W1-01 folder is green (60 passed, 28 skipped, 0 failed).
work_completed: **Sandbox check first: it passed.** (a) The write to `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.sandbox-trial-DAEO-uzme` failed with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`, as it should. (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` worked (`1ae28402…`) and `git update-index --refresh` worked (exit 0). `GOV_ROLE` is `independent-test-designer`, `GOV_TICKET` is `DAEO-uzme`, the top level is `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-70` and the branch is `w2/W2-70`, all as expected. I read the ticket's KPIs and paths, DEC-906, DEC-908, DEC-253, DEC-491, the three W1-01 files and the path map's `acceptance_exemptions`. Then I made these changes. (1) `merge_offences(sha, path, root, exempt=None)`: a commit the merge brings is now accepted when it carries `Role: independent-test-designer` or when its full sha is in `acceptance_exemptions`. The list is read by the existing `acceptance_exemptions(root)`, the same function the history case uses, so an abbreviated sha, an empty list, a missing key or no path map exempts nothing, and `Role: owner` alone exempts nothing. The check on the merge's own changes beyond its parents is unchanged, and so is the offender line format. (2) `acceptance_test_offenders` passes the list it has already read to `merge_offences`. (3) Two new fixture cases in temporary repositories under `tmp_path`, with a stand-in path map written last and left untracked. The first is a ticket branch made before a `Role: owner` commit under `tests/acceptance/`, which merges `integrate` back. It first checks that the merge is red when the commit is unlisted, then that the merge has no offence once the commit is listed by its full sha. The second has two owner commits, the second never listed by its full sha, and runs four ways: [only-the-other, abbreviated (7, 12 and 39 characters), empty-list, no-key]. Each way, the offence names the unlisted commit, and it names the first commit only when the first is unlisted too.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W1-01/w1_01_support.py; tests/acceptance/W1-01/test_w1_01_integration_merges.py
evidence: `git log --oneline -2` → `39574e4e W2-70 (DAEO-uzme): W1-01's integration-merge case reads the exact-commit exemption list (DEC-908)` / `e04e6ee6 DAEO-uzme (W2-70): lead checkpoint after the merge of w2/integrate`. `git log -1 --format=%B` → the subject line, then `Task: DAEO-uzme`, `Role: independent-test-designer`, `Implements: independent-test-designer`, `Rewrite-Reason: DEC-906 (DEC-908 item 3): a merge that brings a commit listed by its full sha in acceptance_exemptions passes; an unlisted commit without the role stays red`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. `git status --short` → no tracked changes; it lists only untracked sandbox placeholders: `.bash_profile .bashrc .gitconfig .gitmodules .idea .mcp.json .profile .ripgreprc .vscode .zprofile .zshrc docs/source`, which are character devices 1,3 (`/dev/null`) owned by nobody, not written by me. `git diff --name-only e04e6ee6 HEAD` → `tests/acceptance/W1-01/test_w1_01_integration_merges.py`, `tests/acceptance/W1-01/w1_01_support.py`.
tests: Every run used `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-70/src` and `-o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed`, with no `-x`. The W1-01 folder before the change: 55 passed, 28 skipped. After it: 60 passed, 28 skipped, 0 failed. The new cases that passed: `test_a_merge_that_brings_a_listed_commit_passes`, and `test_a_merge_that_brings_an_unlisted_commit_without_the_role_stays_red` in all four ways (only-the-other, abbreviated, empty-list, no-key). `test_the_integration_merges_of_this_repository_pass` and `test_only_the_test_designer_commits_to_acceptance_tests` both passed. The 3 skips in the history file are W1-05's retired interim guardrail cases (DEC-084).
discoveries: No merge on `w2/W2-70`'s history brings `c9a08678`; I checked with a `merge-base --is-ancestor` walk over every merge touching `tests/acceptance/`. So the repository case was already green on this branch before my change. The change matters for branches made before `c9a08678` that merge `w2/integrate` back, and the fixture cases are what prove it. The untracked dotfiles in `git status` are the sandbox's `/dev/null` placeholder mounts.
risks: Like the history case, the list is read from the working tree's path map, not from HEAD, so an uncommitted edit to `path-map.yaml` would change the verdict. The guard keeps that file owner-only. The history test's docstring still says the case is "expected red until that entry is committed". The entry is now in, so the line is out of date; I left it because the change did not need that file.
lessons: Earlier tests rewritten and why: `merge_offences` and `acceptance_test_offenders` in `w1_01_support.py`, and the repository case `test_the_integration_merges_of_this_repository_pass` (its docstring; its behaviour comes through `merge_offences`). All three were rewritten for DEC-906 as read by DEC-908 item 3. I used `gov retrieve` once, for "DEC-908 item 3 integration-merge case merge_offences acceptance_exemptions". It returned `FACET_UNAVAILABLE` with no evidence, because both its lexical and semantic indexes are stale, so I read the named sections of the register directly. Read refusals met: 0. Scratch measure of the temp folder at the end (`$TMPDIR`, `/tmp/gov-os-lead-W2-70/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-53rly3o8/claude-1000`): 9 inodes and 28K, with nothing of mine left behind.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: The out-of-date "expected red" line in the docstring of `test_w1_01_history.py::test_only_the_test_designer_commits_to_acceptance_tests` is cosmetic. A later test designer could correct it.
recommended_next_action: The ticket lead verifies `39574e4e` and returns W2-70 to the orchestrator for merge into `w2/integrate`.
